name: Baron's Demise
summary: In Southshore, Magistrate Henry Maleb seeks justice for the contract you recovered. Baron Vardus, a cold-hearted nobleman of old Alterac, signed it, and Maleb asks you to bring him his head.

sections.title: Justice for a Contract
sections.body:
After Assassin's Contract, Magistrate Henry Maleb tells you Baron Vardus signed the contract. Vardus is a nobleman of old Alterac, known for his cold heart and brutal ways. Maleb is not surprised to find him behind it. Southshore will not let the baron send thugs against the town without answering for it.

Maleb thinks Vardus may be among the Syndicate's haunts, in Strahnbrad's ruins or the valley north of them. He asks you to bring him the baron's head.

sections.title: Maleb's Relief
sections.body: When you bring Baron Vardus's head, Magistrate Henry Maleb thanks you. Knowing the villain has lost his own lets Maleb rest a little easier.

faq.answer: Baron Vardus is a nobleman of old Alterac, known for his cold heart and brutal ways. His name is on the contract that marked Magistrate Maleb for death.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Maleb want Baron Vardus dead?
faq.answer: Baron Vardus signed the contract you recovered. Magistrate Maleb will not let him send thugs against Southshore without answering for it.

faq.q: Where can Baron Vardus be found?
faq.answer: Magistrate Maleb thinks Baron Vardus is among the Syndicate's haunts, perhaps in Strahnbrad's ruins or in the valley north of them.
It follows Assassin's Contract, the contract you recovered bearing Baron Vardus's name.
